verdict.rationale: The evidence shows only per-item CLI CRUD, which is a scriptable building block a user could loop over, plus whole-account import and export, which are adjacent migration features. There is no documented capability to select or act on many items at once (bulk move, delete or edit). A community user explicitly asked for batch actions such as selecting multiple items to move between vaults, which suggests they were absent.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
